tls_only_transport.title: TLS-Only Transport Enforced
tls_only_transport.description: All sensitive flows traverse TLS with no cleartext path. Secure value: true.

insecure_transport_denied.title: Insecure Transport Denied
insecure_transport_denied.description: Plaintext/cleartext fallback is denied (e.g. HTTP redirected to HTTPS, no opportunistic downgrade). Secure value: true.

min_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
min_tls_version.description: Minimum negotiated TLS version. Secure value: tls1_2_or_higher (TLS 1.2 floor, 1.3 preferred).

cipher_suites_strong_only.title: Strong Cipher Suites Only
cipher_suites_strong_only.description: Cipher-suite policy. Secure value: aead_with_forward_secrecy_only (no legacy CBC/RC4/3DES/NULL/export suites).

perfect_forward_secrecy_enabled.title: Perfect Forward Secrecy Enabled
perfect_forward_secrecy_enabled.description: Forward secrecy (ECDHE/DHE) key exchange is enabled. Secure value: true.

server_certificate_validated.title: Server Certificate Validated
server_certificate_validated.description: Peer certificate chains to a trusted CA, hostname matches, is in-date, and uses an adequate key. Secure value: true.

tls_root_trust_managed.title: TLS Root Trust Managed
tls_root_trust_managed.description: Trusted-CA root store is curated (no rogue, expired, or unnecessary roots). Secure value: true.

service_to_service_mtls_enforced.title: Service-to-Service mTLS Enforced
service_to_service_mtls_enforced.description: Mutual TLS (client-certificate authentication) is enforced on flows that require it. Secure value: true.

peer_authentication_mtls_mode_strict.title: mTLS Peer Authentication Strict
peer_authentication_mtls_mode_strict.description: mTLS peer-authentication mode is strict, with per-server session-cache scoping (CVE-2025-23419). Secure value: true.

downgrade_and_renegotiation_protected.title: Downgrade & Renegotiation Protected
downgrade_and_renegotiation_protected.description: Downgrade and renegotiation posture. Secure value: downgrade_sentinel_absent_and_secure_renegotiation_only.

hsts_enabled.title: HSTS Enabled
hsts_enabled.description: HSTS is sent so browsers never fall back to HTTP for protected hosts. Secure value: true.

certificate_lifecycle_managed.title: Certificate Lifecycle Managed
certificate_lifecycle_managed.description: Certificates are managed and rotated before expiry (e.g. ACME/cert-manager). Secure value: true.

certificate_max_validity_days.title: Maximum Certificate Validity (Days)
certificate_max_validity_days.description: Maximum certificate validity in days; <=398 is the secure short-cadence threshold.
